root_cause_analysis.summary: The compressed JXL stream controls modular transform metadata. During MetaSqueeze, squeeze parameters insert residual channels into the image channel vector. Later InvSqueeze reverses those transforms and derives residual-channel index rc from the current vector size and transform channel range. For malformed meta-channel squeeze parameters, the old code neither adjusted nb_meta_channels before inverse squeezing nor checked that rc stayed inside input.channel before indexing it. The resulting input.channel[rc] read crosses the vector logical boundary and ASan reports a container-overflow.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch updates meta-channel accounting before inverse squeeze, asserts rc < input.channel.size() before dereference, and adds validation preventing transforms that mix meta and nonmeta channels. These checks prevent malformed transform metadata from producing an out-of-range residual-channel index.
